reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are more than most TikTok magnesium gives me, and $24.99 is an easy impulse buy if a creator's sleep video hooks me. I'd try one box, not two.
objection: Two capsules every day is a chore I'll probably skip after a couple of weeks, and I can't tell if it actually does anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the lab report on the product page before I buy and a creator I follow actually using it; a one-capsule dose would also help.
